name: Ornö
description: Long, moderate Ornö island section with two official SAT day-stage choices from Hässelmara toward Ornö church/Kyrkviken. The northern option visits Skinnardal, Ornöboda, Söderviken and Fiversätra before reaching the church area, while the southern option uses forest, hill, farm and wetland landscapes via Utsiktsberget, Bodal, Kråkmora/Lättinge, Mörby Gård and Lervassa Träsk. Services cluster mainly at Kyrkviken/Ornö church and around Brunnsviken/Lättinge; access depends heavily on ferry, bus 889 and exact-date seasonal planning.
waterSources: Kyrkviken/Ornö church is the only strong public water candidate in iteration 4. Treat sat-orno-kyrkviken-water in facilitiesDraft as the importable record; this waterSourcesDraft entry is prose/provenance only. Exact tap/free public access/off-season access still need local verification, and hikers should carry at least 2 liters.
notes: Route shape: two official day-stage options from Hässelmara toward Ornö church, with alternate access at Ornöboda, Lättinge and Ornö church/Kyrkviken.
Ornö research object is an isolated draft. Do not import automatically into app data.
Iteration 1 favors current SAT public values of 34.1 km, Moderate and 11 hours while retaining PDF/Outdooractive conflicts.
Iteration 2 confirms the official GPX/KML export is about 32.5-32.6 km and open-line/topologically awkward; keep SAT 34.1 km as app-facing value.
Iteration 3 pinned several route landmarks: Telegrafberget/Utsiktsberget, Fiversättra, Lervassa Träsk north end, Svinåker, Kråkmora and Lervassastigen.
Kyrkviken/Ornö church is the strongest utility and resupply cluster; Lättinge/Brunnsviken, Sundby and Hässelmara services need currentness and route-proximity review.
Lättinge ferry access is closed through June 2026 in Trafikverket/Haninge and line 20 evidence; after that, verify exact-date service because summer 2026 static PDFs are stale.
Iteration 2 promotes the on-route MIF/Bodal dry toilet candidate and suppresses the old off-route Bodal coordinate.
Do not render rules, emergency metadata, access metadata, lodging, rentals or harbor services as normal facilities.

facilities.name: Toilets at Ornö church/museum area
facilities.description: Official SAT evidence says toilets are available at the museum/local heritage center cluster near Ornö church/Kyrkviken. Local Ornö harbor/service evidence places WC/shower in Bygdegården, but harbor/customer access and exact public opening hours remain unverified.

facilities.name: Water at Ornö church/museum area
facilities.description: Confirmed exact OSM drinking-water node with access=yes near the Ornö church/museum cluster, about 49 m from the official route line in iteration 2. SAT says water is available at the museum/local heritage center and Svenska Gästhamnar lists fresh water at Kyrkviken harbor. Final hiker-facing wording should still say verify access and seasonality.

facilities.name: Butiken på Ornö / Ornö-macken grocery
facilities.description: Better coordinate points to the grocery in Bygdegården, not the Gulf fuel pump by the quay. Local sources say the grocery is open every day year-round; exact current hours still route to Facebook. Keep fuel and 24/7 card-payment details out of hiking-facility import.

facilities.name: Kyrkvikens Bar & Bistro
facilities.description: Real route-side food service in Bygdegården. Current local page says it is also open in winter for school-lunch-linked daily lunch; Explore lists weekday lunch 11:30-14:00 and Friday evening service, but exact 2026/summer hours remain volatile and should not be hardcoded beyond dated notes. Avoid duplicating this with Ornö Krog/Gittans-KBB aliases.

facilities.name: Gittans strandbar
facilities.description: Additional Kyrkviken quay food candidate. SAT and current Ornö local pages name Gittans strandbar alongside Ornö Krog/KBB; local page says 2026 operation is in cooperation with Captain Smokehouse, but exact current hours remain Facebook-dependent.

facilities.name: Ornö brödbod and deli
facilities.description: Bakery/deli/light-meal candidate by Kyrkbryggan/Kyrkviken, about 26 m from the route line in iteration 2. Operator contact page lists low-season hours Friday 14-18, Saturday 11-15, Sunday 10-15; operator about page says April hours match and hours increase during May. Keep seasonal/current-hours caveat and do not rely on OSM-only summer hours.

facilities.name: Kyrkviken bathing place
facilities.description: Naturkartan/OSM list a natural cliff bathing place at Kyrkviken, about 350-400 m from the route end in iteration 2. Treat as nearby natural swimming, with no lifeguard or service assumption.

facilities.name: Bodal / MIF dry toilet
facilities.description: On-route toilet candidate near MIF/Bodal, about 4 m from the SAT geometry in iteration 2. Explore lists Toalett at Bodal 232 and OSM node 7997530880 has 2025 toilet metadata with fee=no and wheelchair=no. Mörbyfjärden/MIF/samfällighet sources frame the area as association/local-community context, so public access remains medium until a later pass confirms signage and exact field conditions.

facilities.name: Telegrafberget / Utsiktsberget lookout
facilities.description: Official southern-stage lookout/mountain, matching the step guide's about 3 km climb after Hässelmara. Iteration 3 projected the GPX about 12 m from the tower/viewpoint.

facilities.name: Fiversättra farm/village context
facilities.description: Northern-stage farm/village landmark. Official guide reaches the gravel road at Fiversättra farm; do not imply public services or access.

facilities.name: Mörby Gård
facilities.description: Southern-stage farm/village context. The actual farm is about 241 m from GPX; keep as contextual/secondary rather than normal POI unless a route-side sign waypoint is added.

facilities.name: Lervassa Träsk north end
facilities.description: Natural landscape landmark on the southern approach to Ornö church. Use the north-end coordinate as the route-side pin rather than the lake centroid.

facilities.name: Svinåker farm/pasture passage
facilities.description: Farm/pasture passage where the official guide routes through farm buildings, fence/gates, tractor tracks, field and pasture. Use as route/safety landmark, not a visitor facility.

facilities.name: Kråkmora route decision point
facilities.description: Route decision point on the southern stage. Keep private/farm caution; do not imply public services.

facilities.name: Rosirska gravkapellet / Rosir vault
facilities.description: Route-side cultural-history landmark on the local Lervassa Trail and connected to SAT Ornö in Wikidata. Treat as a heritage POI, not an access point or service.
